kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Form IIIq (اِفْعَنْلَلَ (ifʕanlala)) of ثَعْجَرَ (ṯaʕjara, “to pour (something) out”),
from the quadriliteral root ث ع ج ر (ṯ ʕ j r); the intransitive resultant of
that transitive base, formed by infixation of ن (n) after the first
radical, analogous to Form VII (اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)) among triliteral verbs.
As al-Jawharī puts it: صَبَّه فانْصَبَّ (ṣabbah fānṣabba) — "he poured it, and it poured."
g: Of tears or blood: to gush forth, to pour out in abundance.
Of clouds: to release, to discharge (rain).
dr: رُبَّ جَفْنَةٍ مُثْعَنْجِرَهْ وَطَعْنَةٍ مُسْحَنْفِرَهْ تَبْقَى غَداً بِأَنْقِرَهْrubba jafnatin muṯʕanjirah waṭaʕnatin musḥanfirah tabqā ḡadan biʔanqirah(please add an English translation of this quotation)
